runners_data.name: Naga
runners_data.note: Top-rated runner at OR 95 with Buick aboard for the powerful Gosden yard; has form over 10f on good ground but no soft-ground wins recorded (0W0P in similar going), so this step into a soft test is an open question despite strong claims.|
runners_data.comment: Naga shaped with promise when third three starts back and has since shown enough in recent starts to head this 17-runner field on our ratings; she carries 138 lb from stall nine, though a run fresh in 34 days should have her spot on.

runners_data.name: Sharpen
runners_data.note: Finished ninth on her reappearance over 12f on good ground and has been consistently placed at this trip but goes 0W0P in similar going; Jamie Spencer can be patient from a prominent berth, though the soft surface adds a layer of uncertainty.|
runners_data.comment: Sharpen showed her quality with a second three starts back and a win five starts back, and she has experience over today's trip and going to call upon; the concern is whether she can bounce back sharply after two below-par efforts and a 48-day absence.

runners_data.name: Janey Mackers
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist for Menuisier returning after 105 days off; crucially, her two wins in similar going (2W3P in soft/heavy conditions) give her the strongest proven soft-ground credentials in the field, and the extra distance should suit her relentless late style.|
runners_data.comment: Janey Mackers shaped well when third last time out, and a winner four starts back, showing she knows how to find the line; her experience over today's trip and going is a clear asset, though 105 days off the track is the obvious question mark.

runners_data.name: Lady Dora Mae
runners_data.note: Ryan Moore takes over on this consistent Boughey filly who has been placed at 10f and 12f on soft and good-to-soft; very lightly weighted at 131lbs for a 3yo and the quick turnaround (7 days) needs monitoring, though Moore's positional intelligence suits a race like this.|
runners_data.comment: Consistent place-getter who has run over today's trip, Lady Dora Mae brings strong each-way claims after four runner-up finishes in her last five starts, but that sole win six starts back and a below-par sixth three starts back suggest the top spot remains elusive.

runners_data.name: Plaid
runners_data.note: Oisin Murphy rides this James Fanshawe-trained 3yo who won over 8f on standard and was placed over 10f on soft last time; handled soft ground on her most recent outing, though going 0W0P in similar conditions for this specific configuration is a mild flag.|
runners_data.comment: Plaid ran third last time out and was a winner three starts back, so her recent form reads as a live threat; carrying 128 lb from stall 17 is the one factor to weigh against her.

runners_data.name: Electrifarhh
runners_data.note: Ed Walker's 4yo carries the headgear flag (hood) and is a natural prominent racer who has been mapped to midfield because the field is saturated with that profile — style fit is 0.93 against her here, meaning her true racing position is unlikely to materialise and her chance is meaningfully discounted in scenarios that require midfield positioning.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last four starts and ranked 13 of 17 on our figures, Electrifarhh faces a stiff ask here, though a third last time out and a second four starts back show she can hit the frame, and 24 days between runs suggests she arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Rastnet
runners_data.note: Consistent placer (four seconds in last five) who holds the hood headgear flag and has a modest 0W0P record in similar going conditions; John Butler's yard has been active (T14:6/24) and this filly could sneak into the frame if the pace is truly relentless, though she has never won on soft.|
runners_data.comment: Rastnet has been a consistent player without a win in recent starts, posting thirds and seconds earlier in the sequence but managing only a fourth last time out; she has experience over today's trip and going, and a 10-day turnaround keeps her fresh, though her rating of 91 suggests she retains ability.

runners_data.name: Patagonia Girl
runners_data.note: Apprentice Ashley Lewis (3lb claim) partners Hugo Palmer's hold-up 4yo, who won over 12f on good ground and has decent course-distance profile; no similar-going data available but her natural late style is well-suited to a genuine gallop, and the claim helps at the weights.|
runners_data.comment: Patagonia Girl has run over today's trip and returns on a sharp 19-day turnaround, but her recent form reads 4th, 8th, and 5th in her last three starts, with her sole win coming five starts back — and a trainer strike-rate of just 4% over 14 days does her few favours from stall 13 off 124 lb.

runners_data.name: Silver Lake
runners_data.note: Haggas-trained 3yo who has won back-to-back on good ground over 10f and holds a soft-ground placing on the form card; the big question is whether she has enough raw ability (OR 86) to match the market leaders, but her recent form is excellent and a strong gallop will play to her hold-up style.|
runners_data.comment: Silver Lake arrives on the back of consecutive wins and has run over today's trip and going, though her three starts back shows a third and her form dips sharply earlier in the sequence; she carries 122 lb from stall 8 and faces a deep field of 17 as she bids to make it three on the bounce.

runners_data.name: Dream Camp
runners_data.note: Andrew Balding's progressive 3yo has won twice over 8-10f including on standard and has solid trainer form (T14:7/56); races prominently but has enough tactical flexibility to sit in midfield if required, and the longer trip on soft ground is the main unknown.|
runners_data.comment: Dream Camp won last time out and has run over today's trip, but her inconsistent recent record — two wins alongside an unplaced effort in her last five starts — makes her hard to trust, and she ranks fifteenth of seventeen on our figures.

runners_data.name: Folk Pageant
runners_data.note: Charlie Johnston's 3yo won on soft ground (1W2P in similar going) and that is a key positive in this test; prominent in style but has struggled in deeper waters at Class 2 level recently, finishing in the bottom half of the field at 10-12f on good.|
runners_data.comment: Folk Pageant has experience of today's distance and going and showed her quality with back-to-back wins five and six starts back, but three unplaced or minor finishes since suggest she has been below that level recently; 121 lb from stall 16 adds to her task.

runners_data.name: Food For Thought
runners_data.note: Confirmed front-runner for Ralph Beckett whose 14-day trainer record is excellent (T14:8/29); won over 10f on good ground and goes 0W0P in similar soft conditions, which is the one concern, but she is clearly the horse most likely to lead and dictate the tempo throughout.|
runners_data.comment: Placed second last time out and a winner three starts back, Food For Thought brings solid recent consistency to the table, and has experience of today's trip and conditions; however, a speed rating of 72 and a ranking of ninth of seventeen suggest she faces a stiff task, despite her trainer firing at 28%.

runners_data.name: Callianassa
runners_data.note: Brian Ellison's 5yo is a natural prominent type in the data, but the field congestion means she is realistically pushed into a midfield position she does not naturally inhabit (style fit 0.92); her recent form reads 576706 and the dip to OR 77 reflects a horse below her best, making her one of the harder cases to make regardless of position.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last six starts, with a string of sixth and seventh-place finishes making for grim reading, Callianassa at least has experience of today's trip and conditions, though a trainer firing at just 5% over the past fortnight does little to inspire confidence.

runners_data.name: Pendella
runners_data.note: K.R. Burke's confirmed front-runner has won and placed at 10f on good and soft (0W1P in similar going); apprentice Jack Nicholls (3lb claim) helps at the weights, and Pendella's willingness to race from the front makes her a key part of the early gallop, though whether she can last home on soft is the stamina question.|
runners_data.comment: Ranked 14 of 17 on our figures, Pendella is hard to fancy despite a win last time out and a second three starts back, with her speed rating of 75 leaving her well short of the field; she has run over today's trip and draws stall two carrying 118 lb.

runners_data.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners_data.note: The second K.R. Burke front-runner in this race, creating an interesting yard dynamic alongside Pendella; has won over 12f on good ground and placed on soft (1W3P in similar going), with the extra distance potentially suiting her stamina — though she'll be burning energy fighting for the lead from the off.|
runners_data.comment: Dunkeld Dreamer won two starts back and has run over today's trip and going, but fourth last time out after 41 days off is a concern, and ranked 12 of 17 on our rating she faces a stiff ask from stall one carrying 117 lb.

runners_data.name: Bearin Up
runners_data.note: Tim Easterby's 3yo holds two wins on good ground over 8-10f and goes 0W1P in similar going; natural hold-up style for Duran Fentiman suits the anticipated race shape well, and at OR 78 she is well-handicapped if connections have her right after 42 days off.|
runners_data.comment: Ranked near the foot of our assessments, Bearin Up faces a stiff task from stall 14, and her last two starts have yielded a fifth and a second, though she does bring a win three starts back to the table and has run over today's distance and going before.

runners_data.name: Bint Al Daar
runners_data.note: The oldest in the field at six and lowest-rated at OR 70; holds the visor headgear flag and has been well beaten in recent starts (form 215879), with no wins on similar going in the data (0W0P), making it very hard to see how she gets competitive in a strongly-run race of this quality.|
runners_data.comment: Ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Bint Al Daar has finished ninth, seventh, and eighth in her last three starts, making her hard to fancy despite a win two starts further back and experience over today's trip and going.

races.paceDynamic: Food For Thought, Pendella, and Dunkeld Dreamer are all confirmed front-runners who will compete vigorously for the lead from the off on soft ground over 1m2½f, creating a strong, unrelenting gallop that will ruthlessly test stamina. With seven of seventeen runners also wanting prominent positions — including Naga, Sharpen, Lady Dora Mae, Plaid, Rastnet, Dream Camp, and Folk Pageant — the early stages will be congested and attritional, with serious traffic danger developing 2-3 furlongs out as the pace-setters begin to fade and the chasing pack bunches. The field holds more front-running and prominent types than can realistically all secure their preferred berth; Food For Thought is best-placed to lead outright given her confirmed lead style, with Pendella and Dunkeld Dreamer likely to press from just off her quarters, while Naga and Lady Dora Mae are most likely to genuinely secure prominent ground among the contested middle group. This race shape — a truly run, soft-ground test over a stamina-emphasising trip — strongly favours genuine hold-up horses or those who can settle in midfield and produce a sustained late run, as the pace-setters will burn each other out and leave the race wide open for closers with proven soft-ground stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses, Closers Reign
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners burn each other out through the first mile on soft ground, leaving the field strung out and tired in front.
scenarios.body: The strong early gallop set by Food For Thought, Pendella, and Dunkeld Dreamer ensures a genuine end-to-end test, with soft ground amplifying the stamina demand and leaving all three front-runners spent inside the final two furlongs; hold-up horses with proven soft-ground credentials who have settled mid-to-rear can pick up the pieces with a sustained run. Janey Mackers, Silver Lake, and Bearin Up are the primary beneficiaries, each capable of delivering a relentless late challenge once the pace softens in front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Settler Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the well-positioned prominent types settles just off the pace leaders and times a run to outstay rivals in the straight.
scenarios.body: With the front-runners fighting each other, a horse that sits second or third and avoids the early heat before quickening in the final quarter-mile finds itself ideally placed; soft ground suits those who don't have to work too hard early. Naga, Lady Dora Mae, and Plaid are the likeliest candidates, with Buick on Naga and Moore on Lady Dora Mae possessing the tactical intelligence to get cover and produce a decisive move.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If one of the lead trio gets an uncontested or lightly-pressed lead and controls the gallop at a tempo sustainable on soft ground.
scenarios.body: Should Food For Thought or Pendella manage to establish a small gap while the others fight among themselves, a well-judged front-running display on soft ground — where staying power can trump finishing pace — could see them hold on tenaciously. Food For Thought's recent form (two wins in the last four) and Ralph Beckett's strong 14-day figures make her the most credible candidate if this scenario materialises.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Midfield Horse Threads Through
scenarios.trigger: If traffic is navigated cleanly by a midfield type who finds a gap at the right moment in the final quarter-mile.
scenarios.body: The congestion 2-3 out will create gaps for patient, well-ridden midfield horses capable of threading between tired rivals; however, horses redistributed here from prominent roles (Electrifarhh, Callianassa) are racing out of their natural style and their chances are tempered accordingly. Dream Camp and Folk Pageant, both possessing a degree of pace versatility, are better-placed to benefit from this scenario than the redistributed types.

watchPoints.text: Food For Thought, Pendella, and Dunkeld Dreamer will all be fighting for the same stretch of rail in the opening furlong — watch for a chaotic, lung-burning early pace that could shatter the field's rhythm and leave nothing in reserve for the final two furlongs on soft ground.

The prominent cluster of seven runners (Naga, Sharpen, Lady Dora Mae, Plaid, Rastnet, Dream Camp, Folk Pageant) chasing the pace-setters creates serious crowding risk 2-3 furlongs out — watch for horses getting shuffled back or blocked as the field narrows and tired runners drift.

Electrifarhh and Callianassa are both natural prominent racers who cannot get their preferred position in this field — watch for them racing in an uncomfortable midfield role that reduces their effectiveness and means their odds may not fully reflect their compromised tactical situation.

Janey Mackers is returning after 105 days off for a trainer (Menuisier) with a quiet 14-day strike rate (0/5) — watch the market move in the hour before post to gauge whether connections are confident she is ready to fire first time back.

The K.R. Burke yard has two confirmed front-runners in the same race (Pendella and Dunkeld Dreamer) — watch which one gets the cleaner break, as the one who establishes the lead early will have an advantage, while the other could be trapped in a speed duel that burns both out well before the finish.
